title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 Business Analytics for AI spend, usage and value
summary: The roadmap facts, preview access defaults, licensing prerequisites and documented controls are supported. The indirect-cost-only rating conflicts with the Agent 365 licence required for third-party agent analytics; the access-control path and urgency rating also need minor corrections.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes one place bringing AI spend, usage and value together for investment decisions.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Business Analytics brings AI spend, usage, and value together in one place, helping leaders understand where AI investment is going

claims.claim: The roadmap describes exploring cost across services, models, agents and users and understanding business use cases.
claims.quote: Explore cost across services, models, agents, and users, understand the business use cases AI supports and the value it creates

claims.claim: The roadmap describes forecasting future AI spend.
claims.quote: forecast future spend to make more informed investment decisions.

claims.quote: This feature is part of the Frontier preview program.

claims.claim: Preview availability and capabilities might change.
claims.quote: As these features are still in development, their availability and capabilities might change over time.

claims.claim: Frontier gives customers early access to Microsoft AI innovations.
claims.quote: Frontier connects you directly with Microsoft's latest AI innovations.

claims.claim: The app is aimed at business decision makers and general managers.
claims.quote: Business Analytics is a dedicated app for business decision makers and general managers (GMs) to view and track the cost and usage of their organization's Microsoft AI services in one place.

claims.claim: The app has an Overview page.
claims.quote: Overview | How is my organization using AI, what is it costing, and what needs my attention?

claims.claim: The app has a Use cases page.
claims.quote: Use cases | What do people use Microsoft AI services for?

claims.claim: The app has a Cost & forecast page.
claims.quote: Cost & forecast | How is AI cost tracking against budget, and where is it likely to land?

claims.claim: The app has a Users & groups page.
claims.quote: Users & groups | Who is using AI services, and how intensely?

claims.claim: AI services have dedicated pages in the app.
claims.quote: Single entry point per service. Each AI service has one dedicated page, so you can easily move from a summary to service-specific insights.

claims.claim: The app combines licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot with usage-based services such as Cowork, agents and GitHub Copilot.
claims.quote: brings insights for licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot and usage-based AI services, such as Copilot Cowork, agents, and GitHub Copilot, together in a single experience.

claims.claim: Cost & forecast excludes Microsoft Copilot user subscription licence costs.
claims.quote: The Cost & forecast page focuses on usage-based billing. Microsoft Copilot user subscription license costs aren't included.

claims.claim: Overview shows Microsoft 365 Copilot cost as Included in license.
claims.quote: For Microsoft 365 Copilot, cost shows as "Included in license" because it's covered by the per-user license.

claims.claim: Cost & forecast offers a base forecast.
claims.quote: Base or steady forecast, which assumes future usage is consistent with recent usage. Growth forecast, which allows recent usage growth to continue in the projection.

claims.claim: Forecast scenarios can estimate the effects of a spend cap or a model mix change.
claims.quote: Spend cap: Estimate the impact of applying a monthly spending cap. Model mix: Estimate the impact of shifting usage between models or providers.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: A reporting budget target does not create or modify an enforced spending policy.
claims.quote: A reporting budget target helps you analyze spending. Creating the target doesn't configure a spending policy or enforce a spending limit.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A scenario changes only the forecast comparison, not live access, policies, budgets, model routing or limits.
claims.quote: A scenario changes only the forecast comparison. It doesn't modify live access, model routing, spending policies, budgets, or user limits.

claims.claim: The cited AI value methodology estimates Cowork value.
claims.quote: This entire article applies to Cowork assisted hours and value, including customization. It does not apply to Copilot assisted hours and Copilot assisted value, including customization.

claims.claim: AI value does not represent realised savings.
claims.quote: AI value is an estimate of the labor value associated with AI's contribution. It doesn't represent realized cost savings, increased revenue, or a guaranteed return on investment.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure time assumptions used in AI value estimates.
claims.quote: Time per use case | Estimated time a person would need to complete the use case without AI. Administrators can adjust this estimate to reflect their organization's workflows and expected effort.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure hourly-rate assumptions used in AI value estimates.
claims.quote: Hourly rate | Estimated hourly labor cost used to calculate AI value. Administrators can adjust this value to reflect their organization's labor-cost assumptions.

claims.claim: Leaders in the top three organisation layers get tenant-level preview access.
claims.quote: The top three layers in the organization (CEO, their direct reports, and their next level of reports) get tenant-level access to the app.

claims.claim: Managers of teams meeting the size threshold of 10 get preview access.
claims.quote: Managers of teams meeting the minimum group size of 10 can access insights for their own organization, including cost insights.

claims.claim: Eligible managers can access insights for their own organisation.
claims.quote: Managers of teams meeting the minimum group size of 10 can access insights for their own organization, including cost insights.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 global admins have access by default.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 global admins have access by default.

claims.claim: Consumption insights are on by default for GMs.
claims.quote: Consumption insights are on by default for GMs.

claims.claim: Business leaders need an admin to turn on consumption insights before seeing cost insights.
claims.quote: Cost, budget, and usage-based service insights appear only when consumption insights are turned on for your role. Consumption insights are on by default for GMs. For business leaders, an admin must turn them on.

claims.claim: Identification in a permission set determines whether identifiable individuals or de-identified data are shown.
claims.quote: Identification | Whether users can view identifiable data, such as individual names, where your policies allow it. When identification is off, users see de-identified data instead.

claims.claim: The Cost & forecast Users tab lists users with assigned limits when the viewer's role permits access.
claims.quote: The Users tab under Spending limits appears when user limits are assigned and your role permits access.

claims.claim: Export is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Export is only available when it's enabled for employees using access management. It's enabled by default.

claims.claim: CSV download is a documented export option, subject to access and configuration.
claims.quote: Depending on the selected service and your access, the app can provide the following export options: CSV download: Create and download a file containing the selected service data

claims.claim: An MCP connection is among the documented export options.
claims.quote: MCP connection: View the setup information for making the service data available through an MCP connection

claims.claim: Include user identifiers is off by default.
claims.quote: Because user identifiers are sensitive information, the setting is off by default.

claims.claim: Identifiable exports depend on the user's permission.
claims.quote: If you don't have permission to export identifiable information, the setting isn't displayed and the export uses anonymized identifiers.

claims.claim: Effective Business Analytics access combines all valid assignments, including security-group assignments.
claims.quote: A user can receive access from more than one source, such as a system-defined policy, a custom policy, or membership in a security group that's assigned to a policy.

claims.claim: One Business Analytics assignment never removes access another grants.
claims.quote: A capability that's turned on by any assignment is available to the user, and one assignment never removes access that another assignment grants.

claims.claim: The tenant-wide Cowork value metrics toggle is off by default.
claims.quote: Administrators can control whether AI value metrics for Cowork are displayed to users in their organization. This setting applies across the tenant and is turned off by default.

claims.claim: Viva Insights admins can configure Cowork value metrics.
claims.quote: Viva Insights admins can configure Cowork value metrics.

claims.claim: Copilot value metric configuration requires both Viva Insights admin and Chief officer roles, or Global admin.
claims.quote: Only users who have both Viva Insights admins and Chief officer roles, or who are global admins, can configure Copilot value metrics.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no PowerShell or API for Business Analytics calculator configuration or its Cowork value toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: Business Analytics metric calculators API PowerShell; Cowork value metrics FeatureId PowerShell. Read configurations, AI value and VFAM references. The documented Copilot Assisted Value control is not a Cowork calculator or Cowork value toggle operation.

claims.claim: Business Analytics > Manage > Configurations > Privacy > Minimum group size reaches the privacy threshold setting.
claims.quote: To open the page in Business Analytics, on the left under Manage, select Configurations. The page includes these tabs: Metric calculators; Privacy; Manager hierarchy. Minimum group size

claims.claim: The minimum allowed value for Minimum group size is 5.
claims.quote: Minimum group size is the minimum number of people that must be in a group before aggregated insights are shown. Enter a value of at least 5.

claims.claim: Minimum group size does not apply to nonaggregated user-level insights.
claims.quote: It doesn't apply to user-level insights that aren't aggregated.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no PowerShell or API for the app's privacy settings.
claims.quote: Searched: Business Analytics minimum group size Graph PowerShell; Viva Insights minimum group size Set- API. Read configurations and Viva privacy-settings and dashboard-settings passages. These document UI settings, not an operation configuring the app's privacy settings.

claims.quote: When credits run out for that subscription, usage automatically continues on a pay-as-you-go basis.

claims.claim: The app reports GitHub AI credits separately from Microsoft AI credits.

claims.claim: The low cost rating treats the change as indirect-cost-only despite its separately licensed third-party analytics capability.
claims.quote: cost: "low"; licensing.model: "mixed"; "An Agent 365 licence is not required to access the app but is required to view data on third-party agents"
claims.fix: Set cost to 'medium'. Replace the cost rationale with: 'Medium. Core app access in a tenant meeting the 50-assigned-Copilot-licence prerequisite does not require an Agent 365 licence, but viewing third-party agent data requires that licence. Allow for administration and finance time; the introduction specifies no separate app price.' This preserves the verified core-access qualification while accounting for the paid capability in the mixed licensing model.

claims.claim: The prepare rating understates the action scale for automatic preview access and targets within about 60 days.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; risk: "medium"; previewDate: "November CY2026"; targetDate: "December CY2026"; "In the Frontier preview, qualifying leaders and managers and global admins have access by default"
claims.fix: Set action to 'act-now'. On November 25, 2026, the November preview and December GA targets fall within about 60 days, qualifying users have automatic preview access, and access/export decisions require attention under the medium-risk assessment. Preserve the statement that GA rollout mechanics are not yet published.

claims.claim: The service description lists GCC availability as No for Business Analytics Frontier public preview capabilities.
claims.quote: Core capability included with Microsoft cloud subscription | Premium capability | GCC Availability; Team-level AI spend dashboard for leaders to monitor 1P spend, forecasts and savings | Agent 365 Business Analytics (Frontier public preview) | Yes | Yes | No

claims.claim: Feature-specific Business Analytics general-availability licensing terms are not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Agent 365 Business Analytics general availability licensing rollout; a365-business-analytics general availability price rollout. Read introduction and Agent 365 service description; Business Analytics is marked Frontier preview and no feature-specific GA terms are given.
